component.name: Photo Selector
component.summary: Cull, compare and select photographs, with RAW and JPEG pairing

description.p: Photo Selector is a GNOME / Libadwaita application for going through a folder or memory card of photographs quickly: step through them one at a time or compare two or three side by side, and decide which to keep.

It pairs RAW and JPEG files and their XMP sidecars so they move together, shows camera metadata and a focus sharpness score for each photograph, and offers Move and Copy to a Selection folder and Trash, each with Undo. It works offline and sends no data over the network.
